predictions.rationale: Core domain entity encapsulating order creation, status transitions (stock confirmation, payment, shipment, cancellation) and business rules.
API surface for creating orders at checkout, changing status, cancelling, and querying orders.
Handles the CreateOrder command, initiating order creation workflow at checkout.
Executes cancellation logic, updating order status when an order is cancelled.
Updates order status after stock confirmation, key step in order processing.
Handles transition of order status to Paid after successful payment.
Manages shipment command, moving order to Shipped status.
Processes transition to AwaitingValidation status during order validation phase.
Handles rejection when stock is insufficient, updating order status accordingly.
Enumeration/value object defining valid order statuses and their meanings.
